items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I have two brothers, one passed away, both named Jorge like my father.

ctx.x: Any siblings? You have brothers and sisters?
Yes. I have two brothers, one passed away, both named Jorge like my father. In fact one of my brothers named me Dave. I said thanks. Another Jorge in the family.
What do you see in the future for your own goals?
